source: Maintained GitHub main roadmap; statuses reflect verified/reported evidence and reviewed PR/issue gates, not an automated live status feed
completionPolicy: All 11 ENH entries are separate from the ten official V2 tasks; no enhancement counts toward V2 completion and no unmerged or locally tested implementation may be shown as DONE.

items.title: Evidence Explorer & detector-to-dashboard bridge
items.detail: Rahil's detector-to-UI adapter is published for review. Windows reported 143/143 tests but the visible integrated app ran at only 0.54× and event-click evidence inspection is not yet implemented.
items.dependency: Review issue #68, resolve measured performance/equivalence gate #76 and complete accepted V2-006/V2-007 integration; no task DONE claim

items.title: Optional real satellite mission-map preview
items.detail: Original PR #72 Mac verification: 7/7 coordinate tests PASS and actual online satellite imagery loaded. Required Esri attribution was absent and light-theme axis text failed contrast; PR #75 correction is still untested.
items.dependency: Run PR #75 expanded tests and visual/provider checks on Mac, test Windows and offline failure, then review stacked merges

items.title: Innovative Mission Intelligence UI & Focus Mode
items.detail: A clearer map/3-D hierarchy, expandable sensor/evidence panels, mission-stage ribbon and legible presentation-friendly controls.
items.dependency: Stable integrated V2-007 baseline and separate performance-reviewed UI branch

items.title: More realistic 3-D aircraft, terrain and sensor geometry
items.detail: Higher-fidelity quadrotor, more natural deterministic terrain and footprints/LiDAR overlays tied to actual public sensor geometry, with quality fallback.
items.dependency: Measured integrated 1× performance; V2-003/V2-005 geometry tests must stay consistent

items.title: Mission replay, scenario comparison & science debrief
items.detail: Timestamp-consistent replay, deterministic fault scenarios and evidence-based exports that show false alarms and the negative validation findings.
items.dependency: Official V2-006 and V2-007 DONE before starting V2-008 implementation

items.title: Nested sensor-quality truth firewall hardening
items.detail: Enforce strict nested public quality metadata allowlists. A missing allowlist was found; this is not demonstrated detector truth leakage.
items.dependency: Issue #69 review; preserve published sensor contract and scientific datasets

items.title: Mac dark/light-theme detector-demo correction
items.detail: Mac reported 100/100 tests PASS for the dark/light display correction. PR #74 merged into PR #66's feature branch, but V2-006 implementation has not merged into main or been marked DONE.
items.dependency: Review updated PR #66 HEAD, refresh stale Mac/99-test evidence and verify Windows before official V2-006 acceptance

items.title: BITM campus satellite demonstration mode
items.detail: Optional recognizable BITM campus imagery behind a clearly labelled simulated planned flight route, with no real-campus anomaly markers or mine/clearance inference.
items.dependency: Satellite PR #72/#75 acceptance, approved campus WGS84 anchor/bounds, provider credits and offline ENU fallback

items.title: Offline BITM campus backdrop and licensing verification
items.detail: Prepare a small legal offline campus-context image only if source terms permit download, public reuse and redistribution; otherwise use licensed imagery or a synthetic schematic.
items.dependency: Verify exact imagery provider permission, credits, approved campus extent and offline failure tests; no tiles downloaded or committed

items.title: Ballari-to-BITM location introduction for guide demo
items.detail: A short Ballari city-to-campus geographic intro leading into the separate synthetic 3-D UAV simulation, with visible attribution and offline-safe fallback.
items.dependency: Approved campus location and display rights; choose a lightweight static or animated intro after measuring startup/zoom cost

items.title: Synchronize campus satellite context with synthetic 3-D UAV
items.detail: Use exactly one public simulation clock and trajectory to show matching virtual aircraft positions in the satellite-context view and 3-D scene; no second route or real-world hazard claims.
items.dependency: Accepted V2-006/V2-007, issue #76 performance gate, campus anchor approval and geometric consistency tests
